data_description.assist_pipeline: Used when you hold the left touch bar.
data_description.dashboard_template: Jinja template rendered and shown on the glasses for the dashboard gesture or the show_dashboard action.
data_description.auto_gain: Boosts quiet speech (0 = off, 31 = max). Helps if questions are often not understood.
data_description.noise_suppression: 0 = off, 4 = strong. Helps in noisy surroundings.
data_description.head_up_angle: Angle (0–60°) at which the glasses show the dashboard. Empty = keep the Even app setting.
data_description.dashboard_height: Empty = keep the Even app setting.
data_description.dashboard_depth: Empty = keep the Even app setting.
data_description.dashboard_gesture: With "Head up" the app shows the template as soon as you look up, on top of the Even dashboard, and closes it when you look down.
